paper_title: More Tokens, Lower Precision Towards the Optimal Token-Precision   Trade-off in KV Cache Compression
caption: The results of Layer-Wise Quantized Pruning on Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct, with SnapKV as pruning method. KV cache budget=1/64.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relative change in performance across different layers for various configurations of token precision and pruning methods. The x-axis is labeled with layer ranges (Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, Layer29-32) and has a categorical scale. The y-axis is labeled "Relative Change" with a linear scale, ranging from -25% to 5% in increments of 5%. The plot shows five lines representing different configurations: a gray dashed line for the baseline of 4×tokens, 4-bit; a yellow line with circle markers for LB-Avg of 2×tokens, 8-bit, starting at approximately 0% and ending at around 0%; a light blue line with circle markers for RULER4k of 2×tokens, 8-bit, decreasing from around -2% to -12% then increasing to -5%; a red line with circle markers for LB-Avg of 1×tokens, 16-bit, decreasing from around 0% to -3% then slightly increasing; and a dark blue line with square markers for RULER4k of 1×tokens, 16-bit, decreasing from around -3% to -25% then increasing to -5%. The yellow and red lines remain relatively stable, while the light blue and dark blue lines show a more pronounced decline followed by an increase.
